pr_title: Remove hidden but usable CLI arguments
pr_body:
@curquiza found out that we were exposing some internal CLI arguments: `nb-max-chunks` and `log-every-n`. In this PR I removed those two, the only two ones that I found. Those options shouldn't be accessible as non-documented in the documentation or the `--help` message.

Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/3307

issue_context.title: Remove hidden flags
issue_context.body:
Meilisearch exposes some internal CLI arguments (`nb-max-chunks` and `log-every-n`) that are not documented or even specified. However they are still part of the product, and we need to remove them, otherwise they will be part of our stabilized product in v1

It does not impact any team since no team works with these options

review_comments: I feel like we could remove this, as it doesn't appear to be used anywhere now. What do you think?
It is used by milli in the indexer part to log for indexed documents. Used when we construct the `IndexerConfigs` struct.
